name: TC-2057: HQ affiliate details — Payments shows THAT affiliate's money and payouts, with a Forfeited card and no Stripe setup

steps.name: Before Hooks
beforeEach hook
Affiliate commission (RestauNax feat/sales-attribution) is not on this environment yet — /api/affiliates/admin/program-defaults answers 404
Fixture "adminContext"
Create context
Fixture "adminPage"
Create page
The affiliate lifecycle rebuild (RestauNax fix/affiliate-lifecycle) is not on this environment yet — the affiliate details carry no money summary
Expect "toBe"
Navigate to "/admin?tab=affiliate"
Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Affiliate Management' })
Fill "auto-commission-e1be1a7a" getByPlaceholder('Search by name, email, or tag...')
Wait for selector getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: 'auto-commission-e1be1a7a' }).first()
Click getByRole('row').filter({ hasText: 'auto-commission-e1be1a7a' }).first().getByRole('button', { name: 'View Details' })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).getByRole('tab', { name: 'Payments', exact: true })
Payments tab: the cards equal the affiliate's own money
Click getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).getByRole('tab', { name: 'Payments', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).getByRole('heading', { name: 'Payment Dashboard' })

Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).locator('.MuiCard-root').filter({ has: getByText('Earned', { exact: true }) }).first().getByRole('heading', { level: 4 })

Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).locator('.MuiCard-root').filter({ has: getByText('Paid', { exact: true }) }).first().getByRole('heading', { level: 4 })

Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).locator('.MuiCard-root').filter({ has: getByText('Pending', { exact: true }) }).first().getByRole('heading', { level: 4 })

Expect "toHaveText" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).locator('.MuiCard-root').filter({ has: getByText('Forfeited', { exact: true }) }).first().getByRole('heading', { level: 4 })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).locator('.MuiCard-root').filter({ has: getByText('Next payout', { exact: true }) }).first()
Payment History lists that affiliate's payouts (not a 404 / empty error); no Stripe setup card for HQ
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).getByRole('heading', { name: 'Payment History', exact: true })
Expect "toHaveCount" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).getByRole('alert')
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).getByText('No Payment History Yet', { exact: true })
Expect "toHaveCount" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).getByText('Payment Account Setup')
The restaurants tab shows the affiliate's restaurants (this one has none)
Click getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).getByRole('tab', { name: /^Restaurants$/ })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('dialog').filter({ hasText: 'Affiliate Details' }).getByText('No restaurants yet', { exact: true })
After Hooks
Fixture "adminPage"
Close page
Fixture "adminContext"
Close context
afterAll hook
